policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Google's changes to its AI search have significantly impacted the online publishing industry, altering content visibility and revenue models.
A photography contest winner was disqualified after scientists detected signs of artificial intelligence generation in their entry, highlighting challenges in distinguishing AI-created content.
Pennsylvania has enacted the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act, requiring disclosure labels on ads that have been significantly modified or generated by AI.

world.summary: Algeria's parliament approved the deployment of troops to Niger following a recent defense pact between the two neighboring countries.
Hundreds of thousands marched across France in protests over school conditions and policing, leading to almost 1,000 arrests and police use of teargas in some cities.
Saudi Arabia intercepted missiles and drones as fighting continued with Houthis, with Saudi-led coalition forces reporting interceptions targeting Riyadh and southern regions.

The US military has granted Elon Musk's SpaceX access to sensitive space tracking data, which could provide the company with an advantage in tracking orbital objects and raises national security concerns.

us.summary: The Archdiocese of New York agreed to an $800 million settlement for 1,300 survivors of sexual abuse by clergy members and lay workers.
The U.S. birth rate dropped to its lowest recorded level, though an increase in births among women over 30 tempered the overall decline.

Enrollment in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) in the US has significantly decreased over the past year due to Trump administration restrictions, leading more people to rely on food banks or face hunger.

science.summary: A major trial found that the first personalized cancer vaccine significantly reduced the risk of disease returning in patients, potentially marking a significant advance in cancer treatment.
Nigeria recorded its first case of Ebola in the current outbreak, which has been spreading from the epicenter in Congo to several other African nations.
